name: NASA Mars Trek
role: Primary planetary map and layer-discovery portal
integration: Use the portal and its documented service endpoints to identify the local study area and layer products.

name: USGS Astrogeology Interactive Mars Maps
integration: Use as a reference for geologic units and available map services; preserve product attribution and CRS metadata.

name: NASA Mars 2020 Perseverance Raw Images
role: Surface-view evidence for science targets and route waypoints
integration: Link or cache selected images with sol, camera, image ID, location, and NASA/JPL attribution. Do not treat the gallery page as a georeferenced raster layer.

name: Curiosity Proposed Path up Mount Sharp
role: Reference for combining mission routes with multiple science layers
integration: Use as a cited reference example. The page is not a live navigation feed.

name: NASA Earthdata Worldview
role: Earth observation and analog-data discovery portal
integration: Treat as an Earth-data portal unless a specific Mars-compatible product is confirmed; do not present Earth layers as Mars observations.
